new_claim.title: Resolved-curve logarithmic seed bound for rational Laurent phases and complete written affine-W cubic proof
new_claim.scope: For every Laurent polynomial phase phi(t,x) in C(t)[x,x^-1],the zero-exponential part of each scalar flat period of exp(phi)dx/x is O(1+log|t|) on a generic ray at infinity. All actual Laurent orders,critical degeneracies,coincident actions and regular punctures are included. A finite ramification splits the marked branches x=0,infinity and phase0,1,infinity;successive separation gives a reduced nodal curve model and a phase morphism. Phase-one marking is essential,as phi=r/x^2 shows. Explicit credited moderate-nearby-cycle/proper-image comparison and full Mayer-Vietoris chain gluing preserve monodromy and prove completeness of the regular part;no rank-only,cyclic-seed or Morse hypothesis. The distinguished relative logarithmic differential has bounded coefficients on compact pieces and necks,with exact neck formula (a-b+(u U_u-v U_v)/U)du/u. Local descending phase coordinates plus globally continued negative-phase tails,dyadic real-algebraic curve length and Laurent transition bounds give the uniform O(log) estimate. Rational h with v_infinity(h)>0 therefore excludes a rational horizontal seed quotient taking normalized seed to1,or a formal Gaussian unit seed at another point. Exact logarithmic Gaussian transport then excludes P=W(a+bZ+cT+dZ^2+eZT+fT^2)+G for EVERY polynomial G when e^2-4df!=0,including the removed component. Together with the manuscript polynomial,Airy,height and linear-WT branches,this closes standalone PAPER-B-L and completes the six-row affine-W cubic mixed cutoff m>3degQ proof within the paper. Only PAPER-A geometric frame-extraction consolidation remains before a complete standalone boundary proof.
